stories.title: “Extreme recklessness”: Flintshire councillors face vote to condemn their own colleagues
stories.summary: Flintshire councillors will be asked to condemn colleagues who changed the council’s call-in rules last month, in a motion claiming the new process is incompatible with the law. stories.title: Minister wants to ‘tackle pavement parking’ as Wales lags behind UK
stories.summary: Wales’ transport minister has said pavement parking is the single biggest issue people write to him about, and admitted Wales is lagging behind other parts of the UK in dealing with it. stories.title: Flintshire Bridge due once-a-decade cable inspection, with £1.3m set aside for checks
stories.summary: Flintshire Bridge is due its once-a-decade cable inspection, and Flintshire Council has set aside £1.3m for it and the repairs expected to follow. stories.title: Deeside Leisure Centre is over 50 and not sustainable beyond the medium term, says Flintshire Council
stories.summary: Deeside Leisure Centre’s sports hall floor has warped and Buckley swimming pool’s roof is letting in water, according to Flintshire Council papers proposing £639,000 of repairs at three leisure centres. stories.title: Brake testing takes trains off Wrexham to Bidston line with no warning to passengers
stories.summary: Transport for Wales has cut trains on the Wrexham to Bidston line for six days with no warning on its disruption page, and says they will not count as cancellations.
